title: Candle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- candle body -->
  <rect x='35' y='45' width='30' height='45' rx='5' fill='#F5E6C8' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- wax drips -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='50' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#F5E6C8' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='52' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#F5E6C8' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- candle top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='15' ry='4' fill='#FFF4DC' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- wick -->
  <line x1='50' y1='45' x2='50' y2='35' stroke='#6B5B3E' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flame outer -->
  <path d='M50 12 Q60 22 58 32 Q56 38 50 38 Q44 38 42 32 Q40 22 50 12Z' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- flame inner -->
  <path d='M50 18 Q55 25 54 31 Q53 35 50 35 Q47 35 46 31 Q45 25 50 18Z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- flame glow -->
  <path d='M50 15 Q56 23 55 30 Q54 34 50 34 Q46 34 45 30 Q44 23 50 15Z' fill='#FFF4A0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#6B5B3E'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#6B5B3E'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='61' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='61' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 70 Q50 78 57 70' fill='none' stroke='#6B5B3E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
</svg>
